user.title: Connect to Viessmann Decoder
user.description: Enter the decoder's base URL, for example http://192.168.1.50:8099 (without /data). The integration only reads data; it never changes decoder settings.

error.invalid_url: Enter a valid HTTP or HTTPS base URL without credentials, query parameters or a fragment.
error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the decoder. Check the URL and network connection.
error.invalid_response: The server did not return valid Viessmann Decoder data.

abort.already_configured: This decoder URL is already configured.
